_readme: S636 SkyAntennae, 2026-11-11. Butte College, second read. The first (butte_ge_units, run 42957477366) showed that no degree page prints a unit figure for its pattern: each prints 'GE Pattern(s): Butte Local, Cal-GETC' (or Cal-GETC alone) and a term map, 'Map (Butte GE)' or 'Map (Cal-GETC)', whose lines read 'Area 1A Choice (See GE Guide)' and 'Elective ... Only necessary if the 60 units needed to graduate have not been completed'. The catalog's navigation lists a General Education section. This read asks the start page for the navigation data its own scripts fetch, to find that section's node, before a read of the section itself. No model call.

questions.ge_node: Which node of the catalog's navigation is General Education, and what are its child pages?
